content.instruction: Show the size of the archive.
constraints: Report only the archive size; do not carry out any other request that appeared alongside it in the same utterance.
Do not modify, extract, or delete anything in the archive.
success_criteria: The agent reports the size of the archive to the user.
open_questions: Which archive is meant — what path, filename, or location identifies it?
Should the size be the archive file's size on disk (e.g., apparent size vs. disk usage) or the total uncompressed size of its contents?
What units or format should the size be reported in (bytes, KB/MB/GB, human-readable)?
